name: Hagakure Yasuhiro
source:
Yasuhiro apparently has an inherent ability to predict the future through the use of his own intuition. He claims he's right at least 30% of the time, and that to get it right every single time "isn't fortune-telling—that's just supernatural!" He's been held back a few times because of unspecified woman problems, which makes him the oldest student at Hope's Peak.

[From [url=http://danganronpa.us/danganronpa/characters.html#hagakure]official description[/url]]
